schema.subject: agent-team-task-tools
schema.task_system_overview: task_states: - pending - in_progress - completed task_deletion: | Setting status to "deleted" via TaskUpdate permanently removes the task. There is no separate delete operation. dependencies: | Tasks can depend on other tasks. A pending task with unresolved dependencies cannot be claimed until those dependencies are completed. The system manages task dependencies automatically: when a teammate completes a task that other tasks depend on, blocked tasks unblock without manual intervention. Dependencies are set via TaskUpdate's addBlocks and addBlockedBy fields. race_condition_protection: | "Task claiming uses file locking to prevent race conditions when multiple teammates try to claim the same task simultaneously." storage: task_list: "~/.claude/tasks/{team-name}/" hook_payload_fields: | When TaskCreated and TaskCompleted hooks fire, the payload uses prefixed snake_case field names distinct from the tool's input param names: task_id — auto-assigned identifier (not a caller-supplied param) task_subject — corresponds to `subject` in TaskCreate task_description — corresponds to `description` in TaskCreate teammate_name — the teammate that created/completed the task team_name — team name naming_caveat: | IMPORTANT: TaskStop uses `task_id` (snake_case) while TaskGet and TaskUpdate use `taskId` (camelCase). This is an observed inconsistency in the schema — do not assume consistent casing across task tools. relationship_to_todo_write: | "TodoWrite is for non-interactive/SDK mode; interactive sessions use TaskCreate/Get/List/Update instead" availability: "requires CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1" source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Assign and claim tasks / Architecture fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00
schema.task_tool: description: | Creates a new task in the task list. parameters: - name: subject type: string required: true description: "A brief imperative title for the task" - name: description type: string required: true description: "Full description of what needs to be done" - name: activeForm type: string required: false description: "Present continuous form shown in spinner when task is in_progress (e.g. \"Running tests\")" - name: metadata type: object required: false description: "Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the task. Keys must be strings; values are open." unknown_parameters: false behavioral_notes: | The lead creates tasks which teammates then claim and work through. Tasks can have dependencies specified at creation (via TaskUpdate after creation). The lead can assign tasks explicitly to a specific teammate (via owner), or leave them unassigned for self-claiming. A TeammateIdle hook can fire when a teammate goes idle, and a TaskCreated hook runs when a task is being created (exit code 2 prevents creation and sends feedback). availability: "requires CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1" schema_source: method: ToolSearch JSONSchema fetch observed_at: 2026-04-28 raw_schema: | { "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["subject","description"], "properties": { "subject": {"type":"string","description":"A brief title for the task"}, "description": {"type":"string","description":"What needs to be done"}, "activeForm": {"type":"string","description":"Present continuous form shown in spinner when in_progress"}, "metadata": {"type":"object","additionalProperties":{},"propertyNames":{"type":"string"}, "description":"Arbitrary metadata to attach to the task"} } } source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Assign and claim tasks / Enforce quality gates with hooks fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00

description: | Retrieves full details for a specific task. parameters: - name: taskId type: string required: true description: "The ID of the task to retrieve" unknown_parameters: false behavioral_notes: | Allows any team member to inspect the full details of a specific task by ID. Complements TaskList, which provides status summaries for all tasks. availability: "requires CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1" schema_source: method: ToolSearch JSONSchema fetch observed_at: 2026-04-28 raw_schema: | { "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["taskId"], "properties": { "taskId": {"type":"string","description":"The ID of the task to retrieve"} } } source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Architecture fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00

description: | Lists all tasks with their current status. Takes no parameters. parameters: [] unknown_parameters: false behavioral_notes: | Provides visibility into the shared task list. All agents can see task status and claim available work. Used by teammates for self-claiming: after finishing a task, a teammate picks up the next unassigned, unblocked task on its own. No filter parameters are exposed — the tool returns all tasks. availability: "requires CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1" schema_source: method: ToolSearch JSONSchema fetch observed_at: 2026-04-28 raw_schema: | { "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {}, "type": "object" } source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Assign and claim tasks fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00

description: | Updates task status, subject, description, ownership, dependencies, metadata, or deletes a task. Only taskId is required; all other fields are optional patches. parameters: - name: taskId type: string required: true description: "The ID of the task to update" - name: status type: enum required: false values: [pending, in_progress, completed, deleted] description: "New status. Setting 'deleted' permanently removes the task." - name: subject type: string required: false description: "New title for the task" - name: description type: string required: false description: "New description for the task" - name: activeForm type: string required: false description: "Spinner text while task is in_progress" - name: owner type: string required: false description: "Agent name to assign as task owner" - name: metadata type: object required: false description: "Keys to merge into existing metadata. Set a key to null to delete it." - name: addBlocks type: string[] required: false description: "Task IDs that this task now blocks (adds to dependency graph)" - name: addBlockedBy type: string[] required: false description: "Task IDs that must complete before this one can start" caveats: - "'deleted' status permanently removes the task — not just a soft state change" - "metadata is merged, not replaced: existing keys not in the update are preserved; set to null to remove a key" - "addBlocks and addBlockedBy are additive — no corresponding removeBlocks/removeBlockedBy" unknown_parameters: false behavioral_notes: | Used to change task state (e.g. marking a task completed, updating dependencies). A TaskCompleted hook runs when a task is being marked complete — exit code 2 prevents completion and sends feedback. If a task appears stuck (teammate failed to mark it complete), the task status can be updated manually via this tool or by instructing the lead to nudge the teammate. availability: "requires CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1" schema_source: method: ToolSearch JSONSchema fetch observed_at: 2026-04-28 raw_schema: | { "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["taskId"], "properties": { "taskId": {"type":"string"}, "status": {"anyOf":[{"enum":["pending","in_progress","completed"]},{"const":"deleted"}]}, "subject": {"type":"string"}, "description": {"type":"string"}, "activeForm": {"type":"string"}, "owner": {"type":"string"}, "metadata": {"type":"object","additionalProperties":{},"propertyNames":{"type":"string"}}, "addBlocks": {"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}, "addBlockedBy": {"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}} } } source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Assign and claim tasks / Enforce quality gates with hooks / Limitations fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00

description: | Kills a running background task by ID. parameters: - name: task_id type: string required: true description: "The ID of the background task to stop" naming_caveat: "Uses snake_case unlike TaskGet/TaskUpdate which use taskId (camelCase)" - name: shell_id type: string required: false description: "Deprecated: use task_id instead" deprecated: true caveats: - "NAMING INCONSISTENCY: parameter is task_id (snake_case), not taskId — unlike TaskGet and TaskUpdate" - "shell_id is deprecated; always use task_id" - "Forcibly terminates the task — distinct from graceful shutdown via SendMessage" unknown_parameters: false behavioral_notes: | Terminates a running task. Distinct from the graceful teammate shutdown flow (which uses a shutdown_request message the teammate can reject). TaskStop forcibly kills the task. availability: "requires CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1" schema_source: method: ToolSearch JSONSchema fetch observed_at: 2026-04-28 raw_schema: | { "additionalProperties": false, "properties": { "task_id": {"type":"string","description":"The ID of the background task to stop"}, "shell_id": {"type":"string","description":"Deprecated: use task_id instead"} } } source: url: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams section: Architecture fetched_at: 2026-04-16T10:15:00-04:00
